answer: An environmental entropy protocol resists Sybil attacks by binding each agent to a physical sensor node on a remote mesa. The node produces unforgeable attestations by measuring acoustic resonances transferred between a heavy marble base and a piezoelectric crystal detector. An attacker must expend scarce capital deploying dedicated hardware per identity instead of virtualizing instances. However, localized seismic noise can distort resonance profiles, mistakenly invalidating legitimate nodes.
